title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2026〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's see, Miku and the others...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Ah, there they are.
Hey, everyone. Can we have a minute?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What is it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We just finished our latest music video, and we were hoping to show it to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It's fresh out of the oven, baked just this morning.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is this the one you were working on, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That's right. I finally got it looking how I want it to.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I stayed up all night putting the finishing touches on too, so make sure you look closely!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I can't wait to see it. Let's get watching.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, here goes.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well? What did you think?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It was pretty.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It really fit Kanade's song...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Your art was good too, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks. It took ages, but I think it turned out really well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Though, I spent so many days cooped up indoors that I didn't really get to enjoy much springtime.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Here she goes again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You've been saying that practically the whole time we've been working on this one.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, yeah. It feels like all the spring events and limited-time sweets and stuff ended before I even realized they were on.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, I can think of at least one event this season you haven't missed.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Your birthday is coming up, isn't it?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah, I guess so.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We want to celebrate your birthday.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Um... If we hold you a party, will you come...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Don't be silly. Of course I will.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then let's have a party here in SEKAI on the day of. MEIKO, KAITO, any objections?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do what you want.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: These two, I swear. You will still come, right?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm leaving now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, what was that? At least say yes or no!
se_walk_men_001_1
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: They're gone.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. The same as always, really.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is it really okay? Don't you have other plans on your birthday?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It'll be fine. We're doing the party before my actual birthday.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Right, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup, so leave Saturday open.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Are you setting it up, Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's right! We've got plans in motion, all organized by yours truly.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And all without telling me a single thing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's because I want you to look forward to finding out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Besides, I've got you mostly figured out, so you can trust I've got something good planned.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm not sure I like being “mostly figured out” here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Either way, I'm expecting to be wowed.
Saturday
Scramble Crossing
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, were you waiting long?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No, we just got here ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, okay. That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? That's a lot of stuff, you three. What's with all the bags?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, you'll just have to wait and see!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, if you say so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, where are you taking me today?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: A certain someone was really talking this up, so is it a really fancy cafe or something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. Something like that! The atmosphere's something special, so just you wait and see.
